title: Analytical Solutions of 3D Maxwell's Equations via Infinite-Order Curl-Operator Expansions
summary: Solving Maxwell's equations to obtain explicit analytical representations of electromagnetic fields in open-space settings with general initial conditions and source terms remains a fundamental challenge. We address this problem through an operator-based construction, developing an infinite-order curl-operator expansion that yields analytical solutions as function-to-function mappings from initial data and source terms to electromagnetic fields.
